info.title: Date Math
info.description: Deterministic date and time math for AI agents: date differences, business days, date arithmetic, time zone conversion and calendar facts. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base, $0.001); probes and spec are free. All inputs are JSON bodies; all responses are JSON objects. Errors return {"error":{"code","message"}}.
info.x-guidance: Date Math does exact date and time arithmetic so you don't have to. Every tool is POST with a JSON body, returns a JSON object, and costs $0.001 (x402, USDC on Base). POST /v1/diff: days/weeks/months/business days between two dates (pass country, e.g. "US", to skip its public holidays). POST /v1/add: the date N days/weeks/months/business days before or after a date. POST /v1/convert: a time in another IANA time zone (DST-aware). POST /v1/info: weekday, ISO week, quarter or leap-year status of a date. POST /v1/holidays: a country's public holidays for a year. POST /v1/overlap: when working hours overlap across time zones (meeting slots). POST /v1/cron: explain a cron expression and list its next runs. POST /v1/parse: turn text like "next Friday at 3pm" into an exact datetime. POST /v1/city: the time zone and local time of a city by name. POST /v1/recurrence: concrete dates for an iCal RRULE ("every 2nd Tuesday"). POST /v1/business_hours: SLA deadline N working hours from now, or working hours elapsed. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; datetimes are ISO 8601 with Z or an offset; time zones are IANA names. Errors return HTTP 400 with {"error":{"code","message"}}. Also available as an MCP server at /mcp.

start.description: Local datetime in timezone or ISO 8601 with offset; default now

DateOrDateTime.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or ISO 8601 datetime with Z or offset

Holidays.description: Dates excluded from business-day counts (weekends are always excluded)

DiffRequest.description: business_days counts weekdays in [from, to) minus holidays; only for date inputs.

business_days.description: Applied after calendar units; skips weekends and holidays

AddRequest.description: Negative values subtract. Months clamp to month end (Jan 31 + 1 month = Feb 28/29). Time units require a datetime input.

Country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (207 countries); its public holidays (2000–2050) are excluded from business days
